workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
rationale: Bit 0 of the registered Gray pointer is captured raw into wr_seen_rd[0] in one stage, while bits 2:1 pass through g1, giving two stages. A partly synchronised Gray pointer leaves bit 0 uncontained and can be incoherent with the upper bits.
caveats: CDC-017 (Gray pointer not fully synchronised), CDC-032(a) (mixed chain depths) and CDC-004 (a partly synchronised Gray pointer) all describe this defect. g1[0] is captured but unused.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.

author_reading.class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
author_reading.title: Gray pointer has an unsynchronized bypass bit
author_reading.rationale: The low pointer bit bypasses both destination synchronizer stages while the upper bits use them. The destination observes a partially synchronized pointer and can make an incoherent FIFO decision.
limitations: Structural attribution is a proposal for independent adjudication, not analyzer outcome.
Physical timing and metastability requirements remain external.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: Pointer bit zero bypasses the first-stage bank and is consumed with only one destination stage.
caveats: Upper bits have two stages; Gray encoding does not contain metastability on bit zero.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: Bit zero bypasses g1 and is captured raw while upper bits have two stages; Gray encoding does not protect an unsynchronized destination bit.
labels.caveats: Missing Gray delay/skew evidence is separate from this bypass. Raw rst_n release is not locally synchronized or bounded by a release contract; RDC-003 remains a whole-IP closure confounder. Output consumer timing is not specified. Physical closure is excluded.
